dedupe_keys.name: nlr test case repository for high energy study formerly nrel high renewable test cases

description: The National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL) is building an electric grid test case repository for studies of high shares of renewable energy. The page read on 2026-09-26, last updated 12 March 2026, says it provides models and data for scheduling, power flow and dynamic studies, temporal and spatial time series of energy and loads, test cases modified for high renewable shares, and equivalent cases in different simulation tools for cross-validation. Three cases are listed: a 9-bus, 3-generator approximation of the Western System Coordinating Council built in PSCAD and GE PSLF for validating controllers of wind, PV and batteries; an 18-bus, 4-area PSLF demonstration system with added wind and battery storage; and a 240-bus reduced WECC system with a 2018 base case, one year of time series of energy and loads, and dynamic models, a version of which was used in the 2021 IEEE-NASPI oscillation source location contest. Coverage is the western United States interconnection in reduced form plus textbook systems. Downloads are free; no licence is stated, and users are asked to cite the original authors. Caveats: two cases are marked as under development, and the reduced models approximate, not reproduce the real grid. Simulation uses are power flow, frequency response and oscillation studies with high renewable penetration, and resilience analysis of controls. Related records: data-rts-gmlc is another laboratory test system, and data-dr-power-egriddata-repository gathers many test cases.
